mass.title: The client served itself
mass.description: Clients help themselves; servers get breathing room. Every copy grows the company.
mass.tradeoff: Hosting +$32 per sprint for each copy.

premium.title: Now that is enterprise
premium.description: A personal manager helps large companies buy a better package. Copies add their bonuses instead of compounding them.
premium.impact: Per copy: +12% to base large-company bills · +1 sprint of contract patience
premium.tradeoff: Hosting +$64 per sprint for each copy.

small_sales.title: The neighborhood plan
small_sales.description: Small businesses get a clear package without a three-month negotiation. Copy bonuses add up.
small_sales.impact: Per copy: +18% to base small-company bills
small_sales.tradeoff: Hosting +$16 per sprint for each copy. Medium and large bills stay unchanged.

medium_sales.title: The department plan
medium_sales.description: A chain has outgrown the small plan but does not need a procurement committee. Copy bonuses add up.
medium_sales.impact: Per copy: +16% to base medium-company bills
medium_sales.tradeoff: Hosting +$32 per sprint for each copy. Small and large bills stay unchanged.

batch.title: Your answer was ready yesterday
batch.description: Group background requests. Cheaper, but large clients dislike waiting.
batch.tradeoff: Per copy: −4 large-company satisfaction and −1 sprint of contract patience.

instant.title: While you were typing
instant.description: Urgent answers skip the queue. Happy clients recommend the product more often.
instant.tradeoff: Per copy: tokens ×1.1 and hosting +$48 per sprint.

leads.title: Someone noticed us in a chat
leads.description: Four companies are already interested in the product. Their contacts join the lead list immediately.
leads.tradeoff: Potential clients need free seats and a working product.

consulting.title: One tiny consulting job
consulting.description: The one-time side job has been paid. Its money is available for product development now.
consulting.tradeoff: Once per startup. There will be no repeat contract.

credits.title: Provider credits
credits.description: The provider approved an infrastructure grant. Its money is available for product development now.
credits.tradeoff: Once per startup. This grant cannot be claimed again.

maintenance.title: Before anyone complains
maintenance.description: Apply ready fixes to reduce technical debt immediately.

rest.title: The founder stepped outside
rest.description: A short break restores the founder's energy immediately.
